race.description: Ladbrokes Pakenham Cup On Sale (Bm56) Hcp
race.comment: Hard to go past the in form MAGNARDO (1) who is building a fantastic record for Reece Goodwin, too good at Ballarat Synthetic two back before a tough effort at Bairnsdale. Turns around quickly here and gets D Lane aboard who will ensure she's very hard to catch. SPIRIT ANGEL (9) resumes. She doesn't win all that often but ran well fresh last time in and was largely consistent throughout the campaign. She draws well and has claims. PREMIUM RETURN (2) is coming off a maiden win here, starting $81 to defy the market. That was first go synthetic so it could be worth taking it on face value. PONTE ARCOBALENO (5) struggled out to 1400m last time but had been going well prior and can bounce back. ALPINE FOX (3) next best.
